title: Config contract and normalization
summary: Owns the public config.json schema, defaults, warnings, and normalization behavior that Podquilt preserves across refactors.

public_contracts.name: config.json schema
public_contracts.summary: Defines the recognized top-level sections and source/channel/log/http behavior Podquilt accepts.

public_contracts.name: ConfigLoader::load
public_contracts.summary: Normalizes config.json into typed immutable DTOs without breaking historical behavior.

invariants.statement: Unknown config keys stay ignored rather than causing request failures.
Only the literal string "true" disables a feed or file source.
Invalid max_concurrent_requests values fall back to the default and record a warning.
Default channel metadata continues to derive the link from RequestContext.

performance_constraints: Config normalization stays cheap enough to run on every request without caching.
